shellCommands.command: pwd && ls -la && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5

for f in package.json index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done; echo "=== src"; find src -type f | head -50; for f in $(find src -type f | head -20); do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done; ls node_modules | head -80 | tr '\n' ' '; echo; ls __agent_eval__

node -v && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -E '"version"|"main"|"module"|"types"' ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head; grep -rhoE "export \{[^}]*\}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -c 600; echo; grep -E "\b(Button|Text|Card|Container|Title|Flex)\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^(tsc|vite)$"; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $D/Text/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls $D/Text $D/Button $D/Card | head -40; sed -n 1,80p $D/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,60p $D/Button/Button.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -70; ls $D | head -80 | tr '\n' ' '

C=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; ls $C | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat $C/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ----; cat $C/Button/Button.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo ----; cat $C/Card/Card.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60

grep -rhoE "'(display|header|subheader|body|caption)-[0-9]'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/*.d.ts | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -rhoE "\"(display|header|subheader|body|caption)-[0-9]\"" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/*.d.ts | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -n "variant" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer" ; ls /usr/lib/node_modules 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2) ; echo done
rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff --stat
